f13f4de4be388ddd8bee21cf22a5d6936cc20e74: A resort on a human scale, Engelberg prioritises the quality of its welcome and its closeness over impressive figures. Its 70 km of runs suit a 3 to 4 day stay perfectly, especially for families or skiers who don't need to keep changing terrain. Engelberg has kept the authentic identity of a mountain village, far from the concrete resorts of the 1970s. People come here for the clean air, the unspoilt landscapes and a warm atmosphere that stands apart from the industrialisation of skiing in some large ski areas. On snow reliability, Engelberg is in a strong position with its summit at 3020 m: even in capricious winters, the upper runs hold up well until April. The village at 1003 m is also well placed to offer comfortable conditions from mid-December. A stay in Engelberg is clearly expensive: a 90€ day pass, on top of accommodation and mountain restaurants that are among the most expensive in the Alps. It's the price of excellence, but you should be aware of it before you go. In short: Engelberg keeps its promises. A Northern Alps resort that will suit most types of skier without disappointing.
